focus: All-dimension breadth pass over the declared-wire-format gate, affinity relocation, and probe evidence

findingDetails.title: Chat-level session-affinity advisory dropped for every DeepSeek-named channel; no adapter fallback
findingDetails.evidence: The DeepSeek adapter renders only the DeepSeek-specific missing list and returns undefined when the opt-in gate is off; the notification path consults a single first-match adapter and returns on empty text, so the generic affinity advisory never reaches the chat surface (verify-no-warning.txt control C: chat warnings=0 with full diagnosis missing=['sendSessionAffinityHeaders']).
findingDetails.recommendation: Fall back to the generic proxy warning in the DeepSeek adapter when the gate is off, and render the opted-in warning from the composed missing list so affinity survives and stays actionable.
findingDetails.scopeProof: read the full adapter chain (index.ts:3085-3110, 4053-4111, 9177-9179) plus every buildCompatDiagnosis caller; pre-change rendering confirmed from review/change-under-review.diff

findingDetails.title: One of four new gate tests passes against the pre-change implementation
findingDetails.evidence: With thinkingFormat=[deepseek] and sendSessionAffinityHeaders=true the removed implementation yields the same ['requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages'] result, so the test cannot discriminate old from new; the other three gate tests and the fix-command assertion do fail pre-patch.
findingDetails.recommendation: Keep the test but label it a preserved-behaviour pin and reword REQ-006 to name the discriminating tests.
findingDetails.scopeProof: re-derived the removed predicate from review/change-under-review.diff and evaluated both implementations against the test fixture

findingDetails.title: Predicate drifts from its documented shape; thinkingFormat survives in placement and repair code that cannot receive it
findingDetails.evidence: plan.md describes the predicate as requiring a non-official base URL but index.ts:2987-2990 omits isOfficialOpenAIBaseUrl; decideFixPlacement still special-cases thinkingFormat although no path can put it in compatKeys (index.ts:3013-3027, 5899-5913), and four comments still describe legacy->deepseek repairs.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop the thinkingFormat half of the placement branch and the stale comments; align plan.md with the implemented gate.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep of the thinkingFormat literal across index.ts showed only a type declaration, the gate, one branch and four comments; buildFixSuggestion path traced end to end

findingDetails.title: Affinity probe licenses less than claimed: response-only artifact, uncommitted request, provider-wide declaration proven on one model
findingDetails.evidence: The committed artifact is a gateway response with no request echo, so it cannot show the three headers were sent; no probe script is committed; the provider-level compat applies to both llmgateway models while only deepseek-v4.1-flash was probed.
findingDetails.recommendation: Commit the probe command and re-probe with a request-side assertion; state acceptance-not-proof in the md as the image probe already does.
findingDetails.scopeProof: read both probe artifacts and the scratch inventory; confirmed provider-level scope from .pi/models.json and provider-composer.js merge semantics

findingDetails.title: Committed probe responses embed third-party account metadata including an apiKeyHash
findingDetails.evidence: apiKeyHash, organization_id, project_id and log_id are present in both probe response bodies; no credential value is present.
findingDetails.recommendation: Trim the response artifacts to the fields the claim needs, or move the metadata into a note.
findingDetails.scopeProof: inspected both probe JSON bodies and the associated md files for credential material

findingDetails.title: Packet reports Complete while plan.md Definition of Done stays unchecked
findingDetails.evidence: spec.md status Complete and tasks.md T001-T013 all [x], but plan.md keeps four unchecked DoD boxes with no evidence rows.
findingDetails.recommendation: Check the boxes with their evidence or remove the block if it is not the packet's gate surface.
findingDetails.scopeProof: compared the three packet documents field by field

results.summary: REQ-001 through REQ-005 resolve to shipped behaviour; REQ-004's acceptance criterion is under-evidenced but not contradicted.
Evidence rows exist for the code gates, but the plan's DoD is unchecked and the REQ-006 coverage claim overstates one test.
Target is a spec folder; no skill package under review.
No feature-catalog claims reference this surface in the packet.

convergenceSignals.note: Telemetry only: stopPolicy is max-iterations with maxIterations=1, so the run terminates at the cap and does not claim a converged STOP.
